user.title: House sensors and systems
user.description: Choose all member temperature sensors and controlled HVAC systems. Removing an entity here removes it from control.

sensor.title: Sensor weight and zone
sensor.description: Configure {entity}. Weight applies to the mode being edited (the active mode by default). Weights must be positive.

system.title: System preset
system.description: Set a hold preset for {entity}, such as manual, when required by the device. Room effects are learned automatically.

tunables.title: Control settings
tunables.description: Temperatures are in °C. Solar power is converted to kW for online learning. PI integral gain is per control interval.

data.frozen_after: Unchanged sensor limit during HVAC activity (hours)
data.minor_weight_share: Minimum sensor weight share that blocks fan learning
data.disturbance_intervals: Consecutive intervals to flag a disturbance
data.disturbance_clear_intervals: Clean intervals to clear a disturbance
data.learning_pause_hours: Learning pause auto-resume (hours; 0 until switched on)

priority.title: Priority modes
priority.description: Add, edit, rename or delete a room priority mode. Add/edit saves after entering the room weights; rename/delete saves immediately.

source.title: Extra heat source
source.description: Configure {entity}. Binary uses on/off states; power uses W, kW or MW. Threshold applies only to power inputs. These entities are observed, never controlled.

error.empty_selection: Choose at least one sensor and system.
error.self_reference: The integration cannot control or read its own entities.
error.invalid_mode_name: Choose a nonempty, unique mode name.
error.last_mode: The last mode cannot be deleted.
